title: Universal 128 gate-depth lower bound for the scalar response
note: Confirmed the scalar-response target-touch lower bound: gates ≥ 128 and depth ≥ 1 in the exact fixed-register unitary model. Surjectivity and field determinants were independently checked. This is not 128 security bits or a proof of the larger resource price.
